items: Restaurant brands have always wanted personal, responsive hospitality, but handling every guest signal by hand costs too much for a low-ticket meal across hundreds of locations.
Slow replies cost guests: brands that respond within an hour keep far more affected guests than those that take a day, and staff turnover keeps resetting manual feedback processes.
AI agents can understand an issue, reply in your brand voice, apply recovery policies, escalate sensitive cases and spot repeat problems across every location and channel.
Bringing reviews, tickets, surveys and refunds into one AI service layer lets your people focus on the moments that need a human.
Momos builds these AI agents for multi-location restaurant brands, responding to guests, resolving common issues and routing operational problems to the right teams.
